panels.description: Each router interface shows IN and OUT: measured rate / configured capacity (percentage). IN is received by that router, OUT is transmitted by it. Uncapped means no configured rate limit. Click a value for the link history. Probes connect to their transit LANs and test the customer service. Each IPv4/IPv6 indicator summarizes ICMP, DNS and HTTP, with missing or stale results marked Unknown.
